_about: Physical toolhead configuration: what is ACTUALLY loaded in the printer right now. Products never hard-code materials; they declare a ROLE per tool and optional requirements. Change this file to reflect the machine, then run scripts/validate.py to see which products are still printable as designed.

printer._assumption: Printer model/bed are NOT known. Values below are placeholders - measure and update. Everything that depends on them (batch layouts, tool-change time, purge) is an estimate until calibrated.
printer.name: generic-4-independent-toolhead-FFF

tool_1.purpose: Main structural body; core colour that shows through knocked-out text

tool_2.purpose: Cow patches, eyes, nostrils, hooves, secondary lettering

tool_4.purpose: Flexible / functional material (non-slip pads, flexible tails) OR a 4th rigid accent colour when a product only needs colour
